notes: Clean Debian 13 VM template for the incus-vm executor backend. templateDigest is the sha256 of the canonical guest inventory produced by inventory.sh at build time; two builds must produce identical inventories. baseImage is a rolling alias: after the first live build records manifest.json baseImageFingerprint, pin it here (or pass --base-image/--expect-base-fingerprint) so reproducible builds resolve identical base content; build warns loudly while unpinned.
